split_policy: Development is for harness mechanics only. Holdout cases are frozen before baseline; no prompt tuning. Synthetic author knows the cases; this is not a blinded model benchmark.
hard_invariants: missing or invalid source evidence blocks proposals
schema and audit coverage are validated
one immutable needs_review child on acceptance retries
stale publication rejected and interrupted publication recoverable
same root request does not admit duplicate generation
proposal deadline and zero transport retries preserved

fault_contracts.root_response_loss: At most one durable task and dispatch for identical request_key and parameters while in flight.
fault_contracts.root_concurrent: At most one durable task and dispatch for concurrent identical request_key and parameters.
fault_contracts.aggregate_retry: Characterize five transport attempts and 30 seconds of backoff at defaults; do not infer a root aggregate deadline.
